prompt_trim.validation: Run one documentation question, one resource edit, and one acceptance-test question with the flag off and on. Compare task success, turns, and dev/harness/measure_tokens.py. Roll back by checking out AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md and deleting dev/harness/agent-discovery.md if the run is worse.

project_structure_on_demand.validation: Ask where a new data source file goes, with no files open, flag off and on. The on state relies on the agent pulling the rule from its description. Roll back by checking out .cursor/rules/project-structure.mdc.

offload_provider_guide.validation: Implement a tiny schema attribute on an existing resource, flag off and on. Compare compile success, whether the edit matches neighboring resources, turns, and tool errors. Roll back by checking out .cursor/rules/provider-implementation.mdc.

tighten_verify_rule.validation: Make a one-line Go edit, flag off and on. Record whether the agent runs make build, make test, or go build, and whether the package still compiles. Roll back by checking out .cursor/rules/code-quality.mdc.

compact_orchestrator.validation: Spawn the orchestrator on a sketched resource, flag off and on. Compare handoff length, duplicated work, and whether unit tests were run. Keep model inherit. Roll back by checking out the agent file.

trim_lightdash_client_rule.validation: Add a pure model helper under internal/lightdash, flag off and on. Check that tests stay offline and the helper stays next to its type. Roll back by checking out .cursor/rules/lightdash-client.mdc.
